name: merges transitions into maximal half-open overlap intervals
input: two streams that create two separated overlap periods
test:
left = [(1, True), (4, False), (5, True)]
right = [(2, True), (4, False), (5, True), (7, False)]
assert active_overlap_intervals(left, right, 9) == [(2, 4), (5, 7)]

name: simultaneous updates are one atomic timestamp batch
input: one signal stops while the other changes at the same timestamp
test:
left = [(1, True), (4, False)]
right = [(1, True), (4, True), (5, False)]
assert active_overlap_intervals(left, right, 6) == [(1, 4)]
assert active_overlap_intervals([], [(3, True)], 8) == []
assert active_overlap_intervals([(2, True)], [(2, True)], 5) == [(2, 5)]

name: invalid time and value contracts fail explicitly
input: duplicate unordered boolean-like and out-of-horizon events
